svg.title: Pulsus Dash — Service Lens for checkout: 3D dependency neighbourhood above, 2D golden signals below (INC-2041)
svg.desc: The Lens for the checkout service during INC-2041. The top half is a 3D neighbourhood on stacked tier planes: callers (gateway, cart) on the plane above, checkout on the service plane, its five dependencies on the plane below and a second-hop plane outside the estate. Nodes are spheres sized by traffic; victims are desaturated with dashed rings. The causal path checkout → payments → psp-api is lit as a glowing tube with particles and the ⊕ origin beacon rises from psp-api; every other node and edge sits in fog. The bottom half is the 2D golden-signals strip: four stacked lanes (rate, errors, duration p99, saturation) on one time axis, each with a −7d baseline ghost, the ⚙ 12:19 payments.psp.timeout change, the ◆ 12:20 checkout v2.31 deploy (ruled out) and the ⚠ 12:22 onset. A shared time cursor at 12:41:20 runs through all four lanes and up into the 3D scene, which shows the state at that instant. The right column holds the SLO, the change feed and pivots to log patterns and traces in the same bucket. HUD: top bar, Lens header with KPIs, tabs, layer chips, Orbit · Map · Fly chip, application ladder with A2 Service lit, minimap, orbit gizmo and the Time Ribbon.
